description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) that performs a series of automated tests on the Gitweb web interface project. It includes setup commands, test expectations, and various test scenarios covering project listings, commits, diffs, tags, logs, encoding, configurations, searches, and other features of the Gitweb application.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: A function assumed to execute the Gitweb interface with specified parameters and capture output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define a test case that should succeed.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: A function that checks for prerequisites for a test, e.g., highlighting support.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: A function to execute cleanup or setup commands after the test.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: A function to set or verify Git configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: A function to attempt a command that might not be supported, used for optional features.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: A function to create symbolic links as part of test setup.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: A function to change file modes for testing file permission behavior.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: A command-line syntax highlighter to determine if highlighting is supported.
